argv:
import collections,json,pathlib,subprocess,tomllib
r=pathlib.Path('.')
b=json.load(open('/tmp/careops-e22-parent-before-dependencies-metadata-20261012.json'))
a=json.load(open('.artifacts/mvp/E2.2.fidelity.dependency-20261012/logs/metadata-locked.json'))
def ident(p): return (p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'),p.get('checksum'))
bc=collections.Counter(map(ident,b['packages'])); ac=collections.Counter(map(ident,a['packages']))
expected={('kairo-ecs-des','0.1.0',None,None):1,('kairo-ecs-abm','0.1.0',None,None):1,('kairo-ecs-state','0.0.0',None,None):1,('thiserror','2.0.20','registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index','ec86235f5fcc2a73650310756d2ac5b138a5780bbbdfae3eeccec992c435ba4f'):1,('thiserror-impl','2.0.20','registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index','bc04cd3e1236dd4a98afca4569f2deb3f120e5422a4023be2cb683f8486292af'):1}
assert not (bc-ac), f'baseline package identities removed/changed: {list((bc-ac).items())}'
assert ac-bc==expected, f'unexpected package identity additions: {list((ac-bc).items())}'
lock=tomllib.loads((r/'Cargo.lock').read_text()); lc=collections.Counter((p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source'),p.get('checksum')) for p in lock['package'])
assert not (bc-lc), f'baseline lock rows removed/changed: {list((bc-lc).items())}'
assert lc-bc==expected, f'unexpected lock row additions: {list((lc-bc).items())}'
rootm=tomllib.loads((r/'Cargo.toml').read_text()); edm=tomllib.loads((r/'crates/careops-ed/Cargo.toml').read_text())
for n in ('kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm'): assert rootm['workspace']['dependencies'][n]['path']==f'libs/kairos/crates/{n}' and edm['dependencies'][n]['workspace'] is True
packages={p['id']:p for p in a['packages']}; edid=next(i for i,p in packages.items() if p['name']=='careops-ed' and p['version']=='0.1.0'); node=next(x for x in a['resolve']['nodes'] if x['id']==edid); edge={d['name']:packages[d['pkg']] for d in node['deps']}
for n,v in (('kairo-ecs-des','0.1.0'),('kairo-ecs-abm','0.1.0')): assert n in edge and edge[n]['version']==v and edge[n].get('source') is None
pin=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','libs/kairos','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(); assert pin=='832dfb159981f7bd5041e636a7c4d609b2bd6e9c',pin
print(json.dumps({'baseline_packages':sum(bc.values()),'final_packages':sum(ac.values()),'new_packages':[list(k[:2]) for k in expected],'careops_ed_edges':{n:edge[n]['id'] for n in ('kairo-ecs-des','kairo-ecs-abm')},'kairos_pin':pin},sort_keys=True))
